userStories.title: Board, approvals and stream routes
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the board's calls and its live stream through the safe proxy.
acceptanceCriteria: Proxy routes per references/board-analytics.md: GET/POST /api/tasks → /api/v1/tasks (list allowlist: status, agent_id, priority, search, limit, offset, finished_limit), GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks/[id], PATCH /api/tasks/[id]/status, POST /api/tasks/[id]/{approve,reject,run-now,cancel}, GET /api/approvals → /api/v1/approval-grants (allowlist: status, kind), POST /api/approvals/[id]/{grant,deny,answer}
PATCH /api/tasks/[id] forwards only the documented editable fields (title, description, priority, assigned_agent_id, tags, note); others are dropped by the proxy
GET /api/tasks/stream → /api/v1/tasks/stream passed through unbuffered (response body piped, Cache-Control: no-cache, no compression), keeping the proxy safety checks

lib/board/types.ts and lib/board/moves.ts: the columns in order, side states, and a pure moveRefusal(task, toStatus) mirroring board_drag_rules.py's rules from the reference (review→done use Approve, review→assigned use Reject, in_progress needs an agent, a running Task only cancels, done/review need a result, a Mission's own Task can't be started by hand)
Tests: allowlists, PATCH field filtering, the stream passes chunks through as they arrive, moveRefusal for every rule
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: The live board hook
userStories.description: As a user, I want the board to update itself the moment something changes.
acceptanceCriteria: hooks/useBoardStream.ts: reads /api/tasks/stream with fetch + ReadableStream (not EventSource), parses SSE frames, calls onChange on 'board_changed', reconnects with backoff 1s doubling to 30s, stops on unmount; plus a 60 s safety refetch
Tests with a mocked stream: a board_changed frame triggers onChange, heartbeat comments don't, a dropped stream reconnects with the next backoff step, unmount aborts
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: The Board
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see and move my Tasks on a board.
acceptanceCriteria: app/board/page.tsx: columns Inbox · Assigned · In progress · Review · Blocked · Done with counts; Failed/Cancelled/Closed in a collapsed 'Other' column; Task cards show #number, title, agent name and icon, priority, tags, and a StateChip for blocked/review reasons

Drag and drop between columns using native HTML5 drag events (no new dependency); targets that moveRefusal refuses are visibly disabled with the reason as a tooltip/text; a backend refusal shows its message
Keyboard and phone alternative: each card has a 'Move to…' menu listing allowed columns
In Review, cards show Approve and Reject buttons (Reject asks for feedback in-page)
'New Task': title (required), description, agent (from the agents list), priority → POST /api/tasks
Live via useBoardStream; no other polling
Phones: one column at a time with a column switcher
No mascot on the board (PRD-003 rule); set nav flag ready for Board
Component tests: cards land in the right columns, a refused move is disabled with its reason, Move to… lists only allowed columns, Approve calls the route, New Task posts
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: The Task drawer
userStories.description: As a user, I want to open a Task, read its result and act on it.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a card opens a drawer (dialog with focus trap; full screen on phones): title and description (editable), status, agent (re-assign), priority, tags, result (safe Markdown), error_message, blocked_reason, times sent back, cost block from GET /api/tasks/[id], and the notes timeline
Add a note → PATCH {note}; Run now, Cancel and Delete (in-page confirmation) per the move rules
A link to its Mission (/missions/[orchestration_run_id]) when present
Component tests: edit title PATCHes only title, add note, Run now hidden when the rules refuse it, Mission link
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Needs you
userStories.description: As a user, I want one place for everything waiting on me.
acceptanceCriteria: A 'Needs you' panel on the board (and a count badge on the Board nav item) from GET /api/approvals?status=pending: approval cards (subject, tool, risk, cost if present) with Allow / Deny; question cards with the question, its options as buttons and a free-text answer → /answer
Auto shows listening in the panel while anything is pending, idle when empty ('Nothing needs you')
Refreshes when the board stream says board_changed and after each action
Component tests: approval grant/deny call the routes, a question answer sends answer_text or option, empty state
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Playbooks
userStories.description: As a user, I want to browse my Playbooks, run one and watch it.
acceptanceCriteria: Proxy routes per references/agents-playbooks.md: GET /api/playbooks → /api/workflow-recipes (allowlist skip, limit, search), GET /api/playbooks/[id], POST /api/playbooks/[id]/run → /execute ({input_data?, wait_for_me?}), GET /api/playbooks/[id]/runs → /executions, GET /api/playbooks/[id]/runs/[runId], POST /api/playbooks/[id]/runs/[runId]/cancel. The word 'recipe' never appears in UI copy

app/playbooks/page.tsx on GridPage (cards: name, description, step count, category); app/playbooks/[id]/page.tsx on DetailPage: steps with their agents, run history, and Run (optional input as text) → shows the run on a LiveRunPage section with steps progress
Run detail polled with usePoll(PLAYBOOK_RUN) while visible, stopping when the run ends; Cancel run
400 (a step without an agent, no steps) and 429 (too many running) shown in words
Mascot only while a run you started is live: working, then celebrate or oops
Set nav flag ready for Playbooks
Component tests: no 'recipe' in rendered text, Run posts and starts polling, 429 message, cancel
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Analytics
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see what my Automatos costs and where it goes.
acceptanceCriteria: Proxy routes: GET /api/analytics/summary → /api/analytics/llm/summary, GET /api/analytics/usage → /llm/usage, GET /api/analytics/costs → /llm/costs (allowlists: period, group_by, breakdown with the reference's allowed values only)

app/analytics/page.tsx: period picker (24h, 7d, 30d, 90d); KPI tiles (spend this period, requests, cache share, Mission success rate from /api/missions/stats); a daily cost trend line; tables/bars for cost by route, by provider, by agent; spend by lane from group_by=execution grouped by prefix chat:/mission:/board_task: (other prefixes as 'Other')
Free routes and plan-billed session rows are listed at $0.00 or 'on your plan', never hidden
Charts are small SVG components drawing from Look variables, each with an accessible table fallback (a 'Show as table' toggle) and text labels; no chart library
Loads on open and on a Refresh button; no polling
No mascot (PRD-003 rule); set nav flag ready for Analytics
Component tests: lane grouping from execution keys, $0 rows shown, period change refetches, table fallback renders the same numbers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
